title: 皐月賞の後に・鬼の誕生

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin doesn't clinch the win at the Satsuki Sho—the first race of the Classic Triple Crown—but she mesmerizes the crowd with her powerful performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the stands is a young, redheaded girl who is moved to tears by her incredible run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin leaves the racecourse to hone her skills and prepare for the next challenge—the Japanese Derby.
